headline: 15 killed in separate road accidents in Bogura and Sylhet
summary: Eight people died in a head-on bus collision in Sylhet, while seven others were killed when a bus crushed workers in Bogura.
details: At least 15 people were killed and 34 others injured in two separate road accidents in Bogura and Sylhet on Friday morning.
In Sylhet's Osmani Nagar, a head-on collision between a Sylhet-bound Bengal Paribahan bus and a Dhaka-bound Unique Paribahan bus occurred around 7:30 AM in the Kashikapon area.
The impact caused the Unique Paribahan bus to plunge into a roadside ditch, resulting in the deaths of eight passengers on the spot.
In Bogura, a Dhaka-to-Naogaon bound Shah Fateh Ali Paribahan bus lost control and hit an electric pole around 6:30 AM in the Erulia Silkibanda area.
The bus then crushed several workers who were waiting by the roadside for work, killing three instantly and four more later at the hospital.
Police have identified six of the deceased in Bogura, including residents of Gaibandha and Joypurhat, all of whom were local laborers.
The injured from both accidents have been transported to the Sylhet MAG Osmani Medical College Hospital and Bogura's Shaheed Ziaur Rahman Medical College Hospital for treatment.
A survivor from the Sylhet crash, Faruk Mia, shared that he and his friends had visited the shrine of Hazrat Shahjalal (RA) before heading back to Dhaka.

headline_marked: 7 killed as [[speeding bus ploughs into workers]] in Bogura
headline: 7 killed as speeding bus ploughs into workers in Bogura
summary: A Dhaka-bound bus lost control and ran over roadside labourers awaiting hire near Erulia Bazar, leaving seven dead and 15 injured.
details: At least seven people were killed and 15 others injured after a speeding bus lost control and ran over roadside workers in Bogura Sadar upazila this morning.
The accident occurred around 5:30 am near Erulia Bazar on the Bogura-Naogaon highway, close to a school.
A Dhaka-bound Shah Fateh Ali Paribahan bus was attempting to let a motorcycle pass when the driver lost control, hit an electric pole, and spun around into the workers.
Three people died on the spot, while others passed away on the way to the hospital or during treatment at Shaheed Ziaur Rahman Medical College Hospital.
Following the incident, locals blocked the highway demanding the installation of speed breakers to prevent future accidents.
The executive engineer of the Roads and Highways Department has assured that speed breakers will be installed at the spot today.
caption:
